intro.title: Discover the Operational Behaviors Influencing Your Workers' Compensation Results
intro.lede_1: Workers' compensation outcomes are shaped long before a claim appears on a loss run or a premium is calculated. Everyday management practices — how quickly injuries are reported, how supervisors respond, how claims are monitored, how employees return to work — can significantly influence claim outcomes and long-term insurance costs.
intro.lede_2: The Cost Control Behaviors™ QuickCheck provides a high-level snapshot of the operational practices that may be affecting your organization's workers' compensation performance.
intro.instructions: Answer each statement based on how your organization operates in practice — not simply on what is written in a policy or procedure. Select the response that best reflects how consistently each behavior is carried out across the organization.
intro.disclaimer: The Cost Control Behaviors™ QuickCheck is intended to provide a high-level operational assessment and should not be considered legal, safety, or insurance advice. It does not guarantee insurance savings, premium reductions, or underwriting results.
